notes.title: How does a software engineer perform at Google?
notes.summary: A detailed note by Antti Mäki summarizing the principles and culture behind Google's software engineering practices, including expectations of engineers, collaboration models, and daily methodologies within the company.

notes.title: Tavily — AI-Powered Search API for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
notes.summary: Tavily provides a search API tailored for AI agents and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It enables accurate, verifiable web search integration for LLMs, supporting dynamic content retrieval and relevance scoring for improved factual grounding.

notes.title: vLLM Quickstart — Offline Batched Inference
notes.summary: The vLLM documentation explains how to perform efficient offline batched inference with large language models. It covers setup instructions, performance optimization, and usage patterns for large-scale inference tasks in production pipelines.

notes.title: SimpleQA Benchmark — Evaluating Fact-Seeking Accuracy in LLMs
notes.summary: OpenAI’s SimpleQA benchmark measures the factual accuracy of language models in answering short, fact-seeking questions. It tests a model’s ability to retrieve and synthesize information across curated factual datasets using standardized evaluation criteria.

notes.title: QuotientAI — Document Relevance Benchmark and Analysis
notes.summary: QuotientAI provides a dynamic benchmark for assessing document relevance in real-time search and retrieval systems. It introduces a dynamic dataset generator and an evaluation framework to measure how well systems return relevant content to queries.

notes.title: GAIA Benchmark — Evaluating AI Agents as General-Purpose Assistants
notes.summary: The GAIA benchmark tests AI agents on real-world tasks that require web browsing, coding, reasoning, and multimodal input handling. Developed by Carnegie Mellon University, it provides a holistic evaluation of AI assistant capabilities across domains.

notes.title: LeetCode 75 Benchmark — MARCO Multi-Agent Code Optimization Study
notes.summary: A Virginia Tech study on MARCO (Multi-Agent Reactive Code Optimizer) benchmarking LLM-generated code performance using the LeetCode 75 dataset. The study measures runtime efficiency and demonstrates how web search integration enhances code correctness.

notes.title: Lev — AI-Powered Startup Idea Finder
notes.summary: Lev provides tools to discover and validate startup ideas using AI-driven market insights. It helps users explore new business opportunities through structured ideation workflows and real-time data.

notes.title: Paper Thin Personas — Creative Persona Simulation Platform
